entries.reason: R1 — The diff introduces ScalarMaxAttempts and ModeMaxAttempts classes in src/flow/definition.js. createMaxAttempts() routes a number input to ScalarMaxAttempts (validated by isPositiveInteger) and an object input to ModeMaxAttempts (validated for plain-object shape with exactly own auto/manual positive-integer keys). FlowNode constructor now calls createMaxAttempts(maxAttempts), so both scalar and mode-specific values are accepted as required.; R2 — The diff introduces `isPositiveInteger` (rejects 0, negatives, floats, NaN), `ScalarMaxAttempts` constructor (throws on any non-positive-integer scalar), `ModeMaxAttempts` constructor (rejects non-plain objects via `isPlainObject`, partial objects via `keys.length !== 2` and `Object.hasOwn` checks, and non-integer auto/manual values via `isPositiveInteger`), and `createMaxAttempts` which routes non-number values to `ModeMaxAttempts` (catching strings, booleans, null, undefined, etc.). All invalid categories listed in R2 are rejected at `FlowNode` construction time.; R3 — ScalarMaxAttempts.resolve() takes no context argument and always returns this.value unchanged, so a scalar node returns the same number regardless of whether autoApprove is true, false, or absent.; R4 — ModeMaxAttempts.resolve(context={}) returns this.auto when context.autoApprove === true and this.manual otherwise (false or absent), directly satisfying the requirement. FlowNode.resolveMaxAttempts delegates to this method, and deriveNextAction passes the context through.; R5 — All four targeted files ensure consumers receive a resolved numeric maxAttempts value. In definition.js, ScalarMaxAttempts.resolve() returns a plain number and ModeMaxAttempts.resolve(context) returns either this.auto or this.manual (both numbers); deriveNextAction now calls node.resolveMaxAttempts(context) instead of returning the raw maxAttempts object. In get-next-action.js, deriveNextAction is called with flow state, the result is validated with Number.isSafeInteger check, and maxAttempts: derived.maxAttempts (a number) is placed in the envelope. In review.js, getReviewMaxAttempts calls resolveMaxAttempts(attemptContext) returning a number and passes it as maxRetries. In run-gate.js, resolveRetryMax calls node?.resolveMaxAttempts(flowState) ?? 5 returning a number. No consumer receives a raw {auto, manual} object.; R6 — The diff adds PLAN_REVIEW_MAX_ATTEMPTS_BY_ID in src/flow/definition.js with exactly the required values: review-draft { auto: 1, manual: 5 }, review-spec { auto: 3, manual: 3 }, review-test { auto: 3, manual: 3 }. createPlanReviewNode looks up this map by id and passes the result to FlowNode, satisfying R6 in full.; R7 — The diff modifies only createPlanReviewNode to use PLAN_REVIEW_MAX_ATTEMPTS_BY_ID (mode-specific objects). Gate node definitions (gate-draft, gate, gate-impl) and the implementation review node are absent from the diff, confirming they are untouched. ScalarMaxAttempts wraps their existing numeric values unchanged, and the issue-log gate-impl entry explicitly confirms 'R7: Gate nodes and implementation review left unchanged in the diff.'; R8 — src/flow/prompts/plan/review-draft.md is updated to add 'must not present approval or confirmation choices' to the maxAttempts-reached instruction, and the approval block remains gated under 'Approval (after verdict=PASS)', satisfying the requirement that review-draft stops incomplete without approval/confirmation choices and that approval is only reachable after PASS.; R9 — The diff adds specs/250-review-attempt-modes/tests/max-attempts-modes.test.js (293 lines) with explicit test cases covering all areas R9 requires: scalar compatibility (R3 test), mode-specific validation (R2, R18 tests), auto/manual resolution (R4 test), configured review node values (R6 test), resolved next-action payloads (R5, R10, R13 tests), retry consumers (R16, R17 tests), and review-draft exhaustion behavior (R8 test). The R9 meta-test further asserts that key requirement IDs (R1, R2, R4, R5, R8, R16, R17) each have an explicit regression test in the file. A test design document at specs/250-review-attempt-modes/tests/spec.md enumerates TC-1 through TC-40 covering the same areas.; R10 — The diff satisfies both parts of R10. In get-next-action.js, `deriveNextAction(target.scope, target.stepId, state)` now passes the flow state into resolution and `maxAttempts: derived.maxAttempts` is unconditionally added to the envelope for active steps; since `target.scope` can be 'task', task-scope envelopes also receive the resolved numeric value. In definition.js, only `createPlanReviewNode` nodes receive mode-specific values via `PLAN_REVIEW_MAX_ATTEMPTS_BY_ID`; the TASK_DEFINITION review node is not touched in the diff, preserving its existing scalar retry limit. The gate-impl issue-log entry explicitly records 'R10: get-next-action includes maxAttempts for task scope' as a passed guardrail.; R11 — The diff updates the JSDoc comment for runCmdWithRetry in src/flow/lib/run-review.js to explicitly label it 'mechanical subprocess retry logic' and adds 'This does not consume the step retry budget; review verdict FAIL is handled separately.' No functional change is made to runCmdWithRetry itself, preserving the existing separation between subprocess failures and review verdict FAIL handling. The classification requirement is satisfied by the documentation change and the unchanged functional behavior.; R12 — The template text in src/templates/skills/sdd-forge.flow/SKILL.md was updated to describe 'resolved numeric maxAttempts from the next-action envelope', satisfying the wording requirement. However, R12 also requires that sdd-forge upgrade be run after the template changes. The diff contains no updated generated skill files (e.g., .claude/skills/sdd-forge.flow/SKILL.md), and the issue-log gate-impl entry explicitly acknowledges that 'generated file evidence is absent from the diff.' The template-change condition is met but the mandatory sdd-forge upgrade execution and resulting generated-file update are not evidenced in the diff.; R13 — In get-next-action.js, the early-return paths for no-active-flow and completed-flow states return objects with step:null that explicitly omit maxAttempts (e.g., `{ taskId: null, step: null, action: "completed", ..., requires_approval: false }` with no maxAttempts field). Only the active-step code path appends `maxAttempts: derived.maxAttempts` to the result, satisfying the requirement that maxAttempts is omitted when step is null.; R14 — The template file src/templates/skills/sdd-forge.flow/SKILL.md was updated to read 'resolved numeric maxAttempts from the next-action envelope' (satisfying the first part of R14), but no generated skill files (e.g., .claude/skills/ or .agents/skills/) appear in the diff to confirm that sdd-forge upgrade was run after the template edit. The gate-impl evaluation itself explicitly noted 'generated file evidence is absent from the diff but template is in place,' indicating the upgrade step was not evidenced in the changeset.; R15 — All five review prompt files are updated in the diff. review-draft.md, review-spec.md, and review-test.md replace 'maxAttempts reached' with 'the resolved numeric maxAttempts from next-action is reached'. impl/review.md and task/review.md replace 'the definition’s maxAttempts limit' with 'the resolved numeric maxAttempts from next-action'. Every target file listed in R15 now describes retry limits as resolved numeric maxAttempts rather than raw definition values.; R16 — getReviewMaxAttempts is refactored to require an explicit attemptContext parameter (throws if absent or non-object), and runTestReview now passes the loaded flow object—which carries autoApprove—into getReviewMaxAttempts('test', flow), which then calls resolveMaxAttempts(attemptContext) on the resolved FlowNode. The function no longer reads node.maxAttempts directly; it delegates to the shared resolver using flow.autoApprove. Draft/spec retry enforcement via the dispatcher is an accepted scope split documented in spec-review.md and the gate-impl issue-log entry.; R17 — The diff refactors resolveRetryMax in run-gate.js to derive scope explicitly (from retryContext.scope or flowState.currentTaskId) before selecting either FLOW_DEFINITION or TASK_DEFINITION, replacing the old first-match fallback (resolveNodeFor(FLOW_DEFINITION) || resolveNodeFor(TASK_DEFINITION)). The callers warnGateRetryBudget and checkRetryBelowMax now pass ctx (which carries flowState and scope) instead of ctx.config, and executeGateSideEffects loads state and passes it into deriveNextAction with the derived scope. This satisfies the requirement that gate retry resolution must include flow/task scope or current task context before selecting a node definition.; R18 — ModeMaxAttempts constructor in src/flow/definition.js enforces all R18 constraints: isPlainObject() checks Object.getPrototypeOf===Object.prototype (rejects arrays, non-plain objects, inherited keys); keys.length!==2 rejects extra or missing keys; Object.hasOwn checks for exactly 'auto' and 'manual' as own properties; isPositiveInteger() rejects zero, negatives, floats, NaN, and non-numbers for both values. Object.freeze(this) is also applied after validation.
